name: Twitch Chat
description: Your chat on stream, with badges and emotes, read straight from Twitch. Nothing to connect and no bot to add: it works the moment the overlay is in OBS. Twelve controls set the font, the colours, the layout and how long a message stays on screen, and every change lands in OBS as you make it.
changelog: Initial release. The fourth product, and the first that needs nothing beyond the overlay itself: no integration, no list, no bot.
ready_message: Your chat is on screen. How it looks is twelve controls on the overlay, and every change shows in OBS as you make it.
notes: Every message comes from Twitch directly, over the same public connection any chat viewer uses. Nothing passes through Overlabels, so chat keeps flowing even when Overlabels is having a bad day.
Size the OBS browser source to size the chat: the feed fills whatever box you give it. 500 by 800 is a good start for a stacked feed, 1920 by 80 for the ticker.
The feed keeps the most recent 50 messages, which is more than fits on screen. The Chat messages loop limit under Settings, Account shortens it; reload the browser source in OBS after changing it.
